Definition: from G4998; to make of sound mind, i.e. (figuratively) to discipline or correct:--teach to be sober.
BiblicalUsage: The word is teaching someone into sense. The aged women are to teach the young women to be sober, to love their husbands, to love their children. It is discipleship done at home, one woman teaching another.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the church grows when older believers teach younger ones plainly, and sober love at home is the lesson.
